query: For my 80-year-old female inpatient, what is the IQR of single high‑intensity atorvastatin (40–80 mg) prescription duration in women 75–85?
final_sql: SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY duration) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY duration)) AS interquartile_range FROM (SELECT (stoptime - starttime) AS duration FROM prescriptions WHERE drug = 'atorvastatin' AND dose_val_rx BETWEEN 40 AND 80 AND gender = 'F' AND age BETWEEN 75 AND 85 AND starttime <= 0 AND stoptime >= 0) AS d;
